You are a tooling engineer. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of the qualification tools repo (/home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/qual-20261122/tools), detached at HEAD. Edit files here directly. NEVER git commit, never touch the original tools repo, never edit anything under /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge, never call a model, never use the network, never run `uv`. Use the interpreter /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python; run tests as `PYTHONPATH=$PWD /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests`; never pass --cov. Format and lint ONLY with `/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m ruff format make_case.py tests/test_make_case.py` and `/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m ruff check make_case.py tests/test_make_case.py` exactly as written.

You may edit ONLY: make_case.py and tests/test_make_case.py.

PROBLEM. make_case.py writes a fixed sentence into records.json under `turns_since_entry_definition`. It says a scene's exit is allowed only once the clock reaches the scene's min_turns. That is wrong for scenes with a scene-completing incident: the engine skips the min_turns floor when such an incident fires (freytag-forge storygame/runtime/engine.py, `completes_now` around line 1300). A fresh hosted run of scene 1C left the scene by its incident at clock 3 against min_turns 8, exactly as designed, and a blind reader given the current sentence would flag it as a defect.

WHAT TO DO. Replace the definition text, in make_case.py and in the expected text in tests/test_make_case.py, with exactly this text: "turns_since_entry is the engine's own scene clock read from the game state after the turn: turns played since the player entered the scene named in scene_id (turn_index is the engine's whole-game turn counter). An ordinary exit is allowed only once the clock inside that turn reaches the scene's min_turns; a scene-completing incident (an incident with completes_scene in the story package) may end the scene earlier by design. On the turn that changes scene the recorded clock restarts in the new scene, and the exit check saw the previous turn's value plus one.". Change nothing else (keep how the text is split over source lines readable; the joined string must equal the text above exactly).
